name: Enterprise AI Agent and Execution
constraints: WM-AI-001 remains the governed AI System accountability and use-context boundary.
WM-AI-002 remains a durable Agent definition whose identity survives model and configuration changes.
WM-AI-005 owns immutable content-addressed configuration revisions.
WM-AI-004 owns one bounded run and references exactly one effective configuration digest.
ToolBinding is a relation represented as configuration grant, standing agent capability and observed run invocation; it does not mint a subject identifier.
InferenceEndpoint is declared by configuration and observed by a run while identity remains in the runtime or network endpoint master.
Every tool grant pins contract and schema digests, exact scopes, resource audience, effect class and approval gates.
Effective tool authority is the intersection of configuration grant, agent binding, delegated scope and token or resource audience.
Role labels never grant authority; accountable authority remains on a referenced human, organization or operator.
Every delegation hop narrows or preserves authority, retains exclusions and obeys a maximum depth.
Every run records requested and responding models, tool snapshot, ordered trajectory, approvals and outputs.
When overlays apply, a run pins both base configuration revision digest and effective configuration digest.
Configuration, run, model, agent, endpoint and tool service never mint each other's identifiers.
holds: Endpoint and tool-service references require reconciliation with WM-SFT-018, WM-SFT-010, WM-SFT-003 and service boundaries.
The AI-01, AI-03, AI-04 and AI-07 field-level crosswalk is incomplete.
Base models retain source-pin, ISO, deprecated MCP and development-telemetry holds.
Per-tool scope and overlay-digest extensions require multi-profile validation.
Independent Grok review and one frozen audit remain pending.
